_comment: Semantic token → palette step map for DARK mode, retuned to the approved MyCSC dark theme v2 spec (neutral dark-gray surfaces, no near-blacks; elevation reads from progressively lighter surfaces + hairline borders, not shadows). The surface ladder + neutral borders/text draw from the hand-tuned dark-neutral `slate` ramp (values are the spec's neutrals verbatim; `slate-850` was added for the inset/muted tier). Interactive roles draw from THEIR OWN family's lightened steps — NOT from the spec's vivid accent teal (ADR-0034). Fills sit on the most saturated step whose `on-*` ink still clears AA: the status families and accent on *-400 (hover *-300, ink *-950); primary/secondary/ring on *-300 (their *-400 fails AA with any ink) and link on link-200 (link-300 is 3.13:1 on the surface). Subtle tints sit on *-700 (hover *-600) with the near-white *-50 ink, because *-800 was within 1.0–1.6:1 of slate-800 and read as the page colour. The vividness of the 300/200 steps themselves comes from the ramp core's chroma curve (C_FACTOR in src/theme/ramp.js), not from borrowed steps: borrowing accent-500/400/300 matched the MyCSC dark v2 spec's #3BB8B0/#56CFC8/#8AE0DA but broke ADR-0011's per-family re-theming (re-seeding `primary` could not move dark fills). Nav chrome stays on primary steps (surface primary-700, hover primary-600) with the brand primary-500 as the active item under white ink. Verified with scripts/audit-contrast.mjs. Keep keys in sync with light.json. Mode-invariant roles (inverse-*) live in invariant.json.
_comment-inverted: Inverted-surface tier (ADR-0032): white pill on the dark page. Each status *-inverted role is the family's accent ink on white (coloured icon + alpha-wash halo — the wash lands on the pale subtle tint the light-mode alerts use); neutral inks reuse light mode's on-surface neutrals. Keep keys in sync with light.json.
_comment-chart: Chart tokens (ADR-0030, amended 2026-09-03): frozen viz-owned literals, re-validated against the dark chart surface (slate-800) — dark values are selected, not flipped. Same hue per slot as light mode (series identity is mode-stable); every slot sits at OKLCH L 0.58–0.67 and clears 3:1 on slate-800, so no slot needs a relief channel any more (the previous set had four sub-3:1 relief slots). All-pairs safe prefix stays slots 1–3.
_comment-logo: Dark logo per the MyCSC dark spec: near-white star + wordmark with the magenta kite kept as a brightened literal (fixed brand mark, like the light-mode literals — off the palette so consumer re-seeding cannot recolor it).
